visualReview.notes: All sixteen current portable and sixteen shared frames inspected, with full-resolution cassette, stair and distant-envelope views. Revised tread/stringer intersections are closed. Individual lattice consoles, square-perforated folded cassettes, shell color progression, two concourses, six mapped stair approaches, orange/white seating, Cyrillic city lettering, screens and roof lights are coherent. 2026-10-01 filtering follow-up: inspected every newly rendered portable frame and the corresponding shared views. Mipmapped fractional coverage removes the repeating interference bands while retaining near apertures and visible structure behind the panels. No changed geometry, silhouette or panel orientation was observed.

Near holes remain visible; distant panels retain average openness without the prior moire bands or the grain observed in a rejected stochastic-coverage experiment. Conventional transparent layer sorting remains a renderer limitation; no new layer-order defect was visible in these views.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Executed steel engineer, cassette fabricator, stadium operator and rod supplier support the actual individual structure. Eighty-eight consoles follow the structural engineer where the cassette supplier prose differs. Cassette distribution, local section details, seating inventory and roof camber are reconstructed from published photographs, not fabrication drawings. No event graphics or enclosed service rooms are modeled. 2026-10-01 filtering follow-up: the facade sampling defect is resolved in current portable and shared captures. Earlier scoped exterior acceptance is restored with the same documented geometric reconstructions. This is not a fabrication survey, full interior or exact optical microgeometry simulation.
